references.name: Courier
references.description: Woman in her twenties, athletic build, short black bob, teal waterproof jacket, black cargo trousers, white trainers, grey messenger bag.
preserve: grey messenger bag on left shoulder

references.name: Dusk rooftop
references.description: Flat gravel rooftop with ventilation boxes, a water tower at the far edge and a city skyline behind.
preserve: water tower at the far left edge
light_sources: low setting sun from frame left, warm orange
magenta neon sign glow from the neighbouring building, frame right

references.name: Delivery drone
references.description: Matte white quadcopter with a yellow cargo clamp underneath and four green status lights.

locks.text: The courier never changes face, hair or outfit.
The courier runs left-to-right throughout the chase.
The water tower stays on the far left; the sun stays frame left.

capture.look: handheld 35mm digital cinema, natural grain, shallow depth of field
motion_rules: camera moves are caused by following the courier or the drone
no random rotations or teleporting moves
